analyst.summary: Tata Investment Corporation is essentially a holding vehicle for a portfolio of Tata Group shares, so standard profitability ratios like return on equity do not really describe its business the way they would for an operating company. Looking instead at the more appropriate measure -- how the share price compares to the company's own disclosed net asset value -- the stock currently trades at a premium to that net asset value rather than a discount, which does not look like an attractively priced entry point even on the correct basis for judging a holding company.
